dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Ah, she does often have impressive, curious ideas. She really does know how to use unexpected things as potions ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Her bold, "well, I'm not the one trying the potions regardless" attitude toward formula design is most enviable.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: There is much I still need to learn from her...
